keep: Clean crisp frames that show only this creature; the transparent background stays empty. Colors, brightness, material finish and lighting stay exactly as in the still in every frame. Existing colored markings remain steady and the same size. The creature keeps its original body proportions and full silhouette inside the canvas. Keep exactly two arms, two legs and one skull, the same split robe, one bell and one coffin reliquary. Bell and coffin stay the same size and plain, supported by the same hands throughout.

clips.idle: Gentle hunched idle breathing motion: shoulders lift slightly while feet stay planted and hands keep holding bell and coffin.
clips.walk: Slow heavy walk in place on two legs, robe follows the steps while bell and coffin remain held.
clips.attack: Thrusts the bell-holding forearm forward once in the first half and draws it back while keeping the coffin supported.
clips.hurt: Recoils at the shoulders briefly, keeps its grip on bell and coffin, then steadies.
clips.death: Two knees buckle, torso lowers and tips backward onto its side with bell and coffin held close, ending lying motionless.
